articles.title: What a visit to China’s AI labs reveals about the battle for global soft power
articles.summary: China's AI labs are not just technological hubs but strategic battlegrounds for global soft power, as they illustrate the intricate interplay between innovation, privacy, and ethics in shaping the future of artificial intelligence. This unique cartographic representation highlights the critical role of major players like Huawei in a rapidly evolving landscape where the stakes extend far beyond technology to influence global dynamics.
